title: Latency slices diffing dashboard and regression detector (route/model/region)
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description:
Goal: Provide a single-pane operational view and automated detector that surfaces regressions in p95/p99 latency across the primary dimensions we care about: route (endpoint), model (and model_variant), and region/hardware. This ticket implements a 'slice-diff' pipeline + Grafana dashboard that compares current-window quantiles against a rolling baseline and highlights statistically significant regressions.

Background: We already emit per-request latency and have percentile rollups for top-level endpoints, but on-call and platform teams struggle to quickly understand regressions that are localized to a specific model variant, region, or sequence-length slice. Existing dashboards show raw p95/p99 values but lack automated diffing and longitudinal context.

Scope:
- Instrumentation: ensure per-request attributes include route, model_id, model_variant, region, instance_type, sequence_len_bucket, batch_size.
- Aggregation: add materialized views in ClickHouse that build t-digest summaries per minute for the combination (route, model, model_variant, region, seq_bucket).
- Diffing pipeline: build a job that computes delta_p95 and delta_p99 between the target window (last 10m / 1h) and a baseline window (rolling 7d median for same weekday/hour or configurable baseline). Add confidence estimate using bootstrap sampling on t-digests.
- Dashboard: Grafana panel set with variables (route, model, model_variant, region, seq_bucket) that shows current p50/p95/p99, baseline, delta, and a small-sparkline history. Include a compact table of the top N regressing slices sorted by absolute delta and percent change.
- Alerts: configurable alert rules that trigger when delta_p95 > 35ms AND percent_increase > 30% with minimum sample size of 500 requests in both windows.

Out-of-scope: deep-root-cause analysis, automated remediation, multi-tenant per-customer rollups (follow-up ticket).
acceptance_criteria: Per-request telemetry contains required attributes for >99% of production traffic (route, model_id, model_variant, region, instance_type, sequence_len_bucket, batch_size).
ClickHouse materialized view exists that stores t-digest summaries per minute for the slice key (route, model_id, model_variant, region, seq_bucket).
Diffing job runs every 10 minutes, writes delta records to a metrics table, and computes bootstrap-based 95% CI for delta_p95 and delta_p99.
Grafana dashboard is available under Console -> Performance -> Slice Diffing and supports filtering by route/model/region and shows sortable top regressing slices.
Alert rule templates are checked in and can be enabled per environment; alert firing respects the minimum sample size and confidence thresholds.
Runbook and short doc in Confluence linked from the dashboard for on-call remediation steps.
implementation_notes:
Instrumentation: add sequence_len_bucket at the SDK edge (tokenize length groups: 1-32,33-128,129-512,>512) and augment existing telemetry client to include model_variant and instance_type tags. Aggregation: use ClickHouse MergeTree with t-digest codec for summary_hist, windowed by minute. Diffing: a lightweight Spark/Beam job (prototype in Python) will fetch t-digests for target and baseline windows, perform bootstrap quantile difference estimation, and write output to clickhouse.metrics_latency_slice_diff. Dashboard: Grafana reads metrics_latency_slice_diff and clickhouse summaries; panels include: slice table, selected-slice time-series overlay (current vs baseline), and heatmap of sequence_length vs delta_p95.

Sampling & stats: require min_samples=500 for both windows; use 1k bootstrap iterations for CI; mark diffs as 'significant' if the 95% bootstrap CI does not include zero. Store both absolute_ms and percent_delta fields.

Perf cost: materialized views will increase ClickHouse storage ~8-12% and CPU for aggregation during high traffic; we will cap slice cardinality by only materializing common model variants and regions for the first rollout.
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (canary): instrument 20% of traffic for two high-volume routes and three models in us-west-2, run the diffing job in dry-run mode, and validate dashboard metrics against raw query results. Phase 2: widen to top 10 routes and all regions, enable alerting for platform SRE. Phase 3: full-prod with retention 30d and dashboard exposed to Console users. Toggle flags in runtime-config to limit slice cardinality. Backfill: run aggregated job to populate last 14 days for UX.
test_plan: Unit tests for t-digest merge and bootstrap logic, integration test that simulates synthetic regressions (increase latency by 40ms for a specific slice) and asserts diff job flags it as significant, end-to-end check that Grafana panel shows the synthetic regression. Load test the ClickHouse materialized view insertion at peak QPS using a replay harness (tokens/sec profile already available).
